text:
One: pay off expensive debt. A store card or credit card can legally charge up to the repo rate plus 14 percentage points a year, which is over 20% right now. R6,000 on a store card at 20% costs about R1,200 a year in interest, so paying it off is like earning 20% on your money, guaranteed. Two: build an emergency fund, a few months of expenses saved where you can reach them quickly, so January doesn't push you to borrow.

Full guide: "Your Bonus or 13th Cheque: How It's Taxed and What to Do With It (South Africa 2026)" on the Money From Zero channel.
